name: Crop raw data
summary: Crops continuous MEG/EEG data (MNE raw FIF) to a time window between tmin and tmax seconds with MNE-Python raw.crop.
description: Loads the raw recording and keeps only the interval [tmin, tmax] (from the start or to the end when either is empty), saving raw.fif. Use it to drop unwanted parts of a recording, such as the period before the task starts, before further processing.

parameters.description: Start time of the raw data to use in seconds (must be >= 0).
End time of the raw data to use in seconds (cannot exceed data duration). If None (default), the current end of the data is used.
